entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Probably didn't expect to be meeting me[n]at the batting center, huh?
It's a surprise, yeah.[clr 27]
Not at all.
What are you scheming?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I thought so. But I'm glad you decided[n]to humor me.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well, that's a relief. I'm glad you came[n]out here, at any rate.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You don't have to look so concerned![n]We're only at a batting cage!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Batting helps train your reflexes and[n]dynamic vision. It also strengthens[n]your stance.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: And really, those are important[n]elements in gymnastics, too!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...It all sounds pretty plausible, right?[n]Actually, I just wanted to come here.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Honestly, I wanted you to see me[n]hit a home run.
This seems kind of sudden.
If I'm just watching...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I remembered something from when I[n]was little. My father used to take me to[n]the batting cages a lot.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: The other kids were scared of getting[n]hit by the baseballs, but I just loved[n]swinging the bat around.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Every time I hit one, I kept thinking,[n]"It doesn't matter how fast they are![n]I'll slam them into orbit!"

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I thought if I tried to put myself back in[n]that headspace, I could get some ideas[n]on how to get my boldness back.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What do you think? That could work,[n]right?
It is a good idea.
Go ahead. I'll watch.[clr 27]
Maybe stick to gymnastics.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Right? I think it'll really help!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I feel so energized now! I'll show you[n]what I can do, [lName]-senpai!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I-I see why you'd say that, but it's[n]good to have a change of pace!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Next up to the plate: Kasumi Yoshizawa![n]Here I go!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Now, come on!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: W-Were they always this fast!?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'll get the next one...!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Okay, no more warm-ups! From now on,[n]it's gonna be 100% home runs!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Eep!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Wh-What the...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I-I'm sorry... I knew I was rusty, but[n]I didn't expect to miss ALL of them...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I never see the ball coming, and I keep[n]flinching... I didn't think my slump was[n]hitting me this hard...
Don't give up yet.
Just don't lose hope.
You can beat this, right?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Senpai...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You're right! I'll give it one more shot!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Stay calm... don't be scared... Eyes on[n]the ball...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Here I go!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Come on...!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Wha—

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I did it...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I did it, Senpai! I hit the ball!
Congratulations.
I saw![clr 27]
How's that feel?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'd never have done it without your[n]encouragement, Senpai!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I knew you were watching me! That's[n]how I did my best!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's like this huge weight off of my[n]shoulders. I feel so great right now!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Up until now, I've only been working[n]for myself. I was so desperate to[n]make a good impression.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But since I started hanging out with you,[n][lName]-senpai, I started feeling like[n]I wanted to live up to your expectations.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: And that feeling's helped me feel[n]so much stronger!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'd forgotten how it felt to work that[n]hard on someone else's behalf...
That's important.[clr 27]
Don't forget how that feels.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Right! Thank you very much!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Right, of course!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Ever since I met you, Senpai, I've been[n]discovering so many things about myself.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But now, I feel like I'm closer than ever[n]to getting my confidence back.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, right! I've been feeling a lot more[n]limber and energized lately, too!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm not totally back to normal yet, but[n]even my grades have been going back[n]up.
Nicely done.
It's not over yet.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yeah! I still need to show you what[n]I can do!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Next time, you won't have to watch me[n]fumbling with a bat—I'll show you an[n]all-new, full-power gymnastics routine!
I can sense Kasumi's intense[n]trust in me...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Anyway, we've still got a lot to hit![n]I think it's your turn, Senpai!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Give it all the guts you've got! Smash it[n]into outer space!
I sweated it out in a batting[n]session with Kasumi...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, sorry, I need to get going.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you very much for today!
